id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31ae: "Mister... if you go to battle, please do well for my share too...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31b9: "They say few were hurt this time, so I get the maid all to myself. Heh heh, lucky I got hurt.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31c6: "For you I'd heal any injury or illness right away! So go on a date with me!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31e7: "When we fought a pack of monsters outside the bastion, I saw an unbelievable sight.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31f2: "Behind the swarm of attacking monsters stood a human man.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31fc: "I've been thinking ever since... whether what we're fighting really is monsters...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|320c: "According to the lookouts, this monster army's attack is the largest yet...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3219: "You just arrived at the bastion and got dragged into such a battle. You're unlucky.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3227: "The monsters seem to have retreated, but we can't let our guard down. I'll keep a sharp watch!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3238: "I used to be in Lord Jasper's unit, and Lord Jasper and Lord Hendrik were best friends since childhood.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3243: "They quarreled, but trained together every day, and surely trusted each other most.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|324e: "Those two side by side on the field looked huge. Just seeing them gave us soldiers courage.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|325f: "Even just sleeping makes you hungry. Living is hard.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|327e: "This building was a church, but the inside collapsed and it's dangerous, so the church moved deeper into the bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|329e: "This building was a church, but the inside collapsed and it's dangerous, so the church moved deeper into the bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|328d: "It can't be helped for safety, but without the morning prayers and bells, I feel kind of lonely...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ad: "Looking at this church reminds me of nights back home. Streetlight reflected in the stained glass was so beautiful...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32c1: "This giant crossbow is ready to fire anytime! Monsters! Come at me from anywhere!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32cf: "This giant crossbow didn't get its turn this time either!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32dd: "This giant crossbow is ready to fire anytime! I'll protect the bastion!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32eb: "In the end, the giant crossbow was never fired! Well, peace is the best thing!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32f7: "This giant crossbow's retired too! To thank it for all it did, I'll maintain it well!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|331d: "Ow... I slipped off that ladder when climbing. I'm really clumsy.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|332c: "I'm clumsy... at important times like this I'm sure to botch something...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3335: "If I'd known, I'd have bought up all of Granny Imelda's effective monster-repelling holy water...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3342: "I feel like I survived again thanks to Granny Imelda's holy water. Granny is amazing!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3350: "I feel like I survived again thanks to Granny Imelda's holy water. Granny is amazing!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|335f: "Being alive and seeing the sun is thanks to Granny Imelda's holy water. Next time I'll buy about thirty bottles!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|336e: "Did you buy Granny Imelda's holy water? If you're setting out to save the world, buy plenty!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3386: "I am Lord Hendrik's first subordinate! I won't let them leave a footprint on the bastion!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3394: "Thank you, {var:1}! Lord Hendrik is fighting alone! Please help him!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33a5: "Without you, our victory in this battle would have been impossible.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33ad: "It's as if the great tree of life sent you to tell us humans not to give up yet...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33c0: "You and Lord Hendrik are the last hope of all humans living on this continent...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33e8: "You and Lord Hendrik are the last hope of all humans living on this continent...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33ca: "Please defeat the monster nesting in Heliodor Castle that creates eternal dark and bring back the sunlight.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33f2: "Please defeat the monster nesting in Heliodor Castle that creates eternal dark and bring back the sunlight.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33d7: "Lord Hendrik is waiting for you outside the bastion with Ritaliphon. Take care... I pray for your success.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3402: "You two will surely defeat the Dark One's minions who torment people. Take care... I pray for your success.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3416: "I wish you'd seen the king's joy when Lord Hendrik brought Princess Jade back to the bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3422: "That stern king bawled, and Lord Hendrik started crying too, while Princess Jade laughed in exasperation.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3442: "The Last Bastion is a natural rock fortress. Leave it to us Heliodor soldiers, and hurry to the hero outside.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3456: "...Oh! One thing, don't forget! Do your praying and shopping at the bastion! Outside the bastion is a death zone!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3468: "Welcome back, {var:1}. This victory is above all thanks to you and Lord Hendrik.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3471: "Leave the rest to us Heliodor soldiers and rest your body for now.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|347e: "Leave the Last Bastion to us Heliodor soldiers. Expose the evil monster bringing eternal dark and bury it!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|348e: "If I may give one piece of advice, do your praying and shopping at the bastion. ...Outside the bastion is a death zone.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34a2: "Sunlight feels so nice. Playing in the water like this reminds me of when I was a little girl.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34b1: "But if Lord Hendrik saw me like a child, I'd be embarrassed. Please keep it a secret.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34bf: "...What? Lord Hendrik is nearby? Oh no! Did he see me playing in the water...? My heart's pounding.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34ce: "Luminary, I have a request. If Heliodor is restored and Lord Hendrik returns...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34d9: "please tell Lord Hendrik to keep me by his side as a soldier of his unit again.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34e8: "The road to Soltiana Coast is beyond Napgarna Jungle to the west. I wish you success on your journey...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34fb: "Princess Jade and Lord Hendrik. Watching the two standing side by side, I can't help being captivated.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3518: "Princess Jade and Lord Hendrik. Watching the two standing side by side, I can't help being captivated.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3505: "Manly, dignified Lord Hendrik and strong, noble, beautiful Princess Jade. Annoying, but they suit each other perfectly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3522: "Manly, dignified Lord Hendrik and strong, noble, beautiful Princess Jade. Annoying, but they suit each other perfectly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|353d: "Ugh! Going for my feet, how cowardly, monster!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3548: "Thanks! My feet are my weak point. You saved me!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3555: "Don't relax yet. The monsters we beat were just a fraction. They'll attack again soon.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3569: "Not moon-viewing sake but sun-viewing sake! For us now, sunlight is the best snack!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3582: "We're Heliodor's Three Blades! They call me Winnie the Slasher! Come at me, monster!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3592: "Whoa! That was close! You really are as strong as the rumors say!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|359f: "My legs gave out and I can't stand. I'll rest a bit and then return to the Last Bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35ae: "The hero is waiting for you outside the bastion. Finish preparing and meet him.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35b8: "It'll be a dangerous fight, but with your strength I believe you can defeat the monster creating eternal dark...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35c8: "It'll be a dangerous fight, but with your strength I believe you can defeat the monster creating eternal dark...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35d9: "Captain Hendrik. Thank you for all you've done. Until you return to the bastion, we Heliodor knights will protect the people!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35ec: "Maybe because I haven't seen the sun in so long, at night I feel like morning won't come, and it makes me anxious.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3607: "Ugh! What a weird smell! These guys are rotten!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3610: "I'm a clean freak. You saved me, thanks!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|361d: "I'm a clean freak... Stinking monster juice got on the soles of my boots.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3624: "I want to go back to the Last Bastion soon and wash it clean.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3638: "Honestly, the king called Lord Hendrik again!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|363e: "Lord Hendrik is too nice! If it's an unreasonable request, he could turn it down once!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|364d: "How nostalgic, Soltiana Coast. It's a famous summer retreat with lots of noble villas.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3659: "When the world was peaceful, I often accompanied Lord Jasper and swam on the beautiful beach.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3675: "This child was crying in Heliodor's castle town the day the great tree fell. I thought it a miracle I found them.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3686: "The house had burned down, but the mother protected the child with her body, so only this child survived.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3691: "I want to name them soon, but no good name comes to mind. I'm thinking about what to do.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|369e: "Shh... quiet. The baby just fell asleep, so please don't talk to me.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36ae: "When this child grows up, I want them to be a strong, kind, fine man like the Luminary.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36f2: "When this child grows up, I want them to be a strong, kind, fine man like the Luminary.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36b8: "...So, if it's all right, may I name this child after your name?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36fc: "...So, if it's all right, may I name this child after your name?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36c5: "Thank you! Then I'll borrow your name and the name of the hero of my favorite story...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3709: "Thank you! Then I'll borrow your name and the name of the hero of my favorite story...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36d1: "...This child's name is {var:1} Ton Nularia II! Oh, what a wonderful name!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3715: "...This child's name is {var:1} Ton Nularia II! Oh, what a wonderful name!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36de: "Oh, is that so, how disappointing... Then it can't be helped. This child's name is Nelchoy. Not a very striking name.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3722: "Oh, is that so, how disappointing... Then it can't be helped. This child's name is Nelchoy. Not a very striking name.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|374b: "We're Heliodor's Three Blades! They call me Itor Divine Punishment! You won't escape, monster!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|375c: "I thought I'd die! Silky-haired mister, thank you so much!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3769: "It was my first time fighting monsters. I hope this is the only day I feel such terror, ever.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|378f: "So our hero returns. The people will gather at the north entrance to welcome him.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|379e: "...Perhaps you don't want it, but please go welcome him too.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37aa: "Survive tonight's battle and victory is ours! Head outside the bastion! {var:1}, I entrust Hendrik to you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37c1: "The path to the underground waterway that can sneak into Heliodor Castle is on the cliff of Heliodor Hill.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37f4: "The path to the underground waterway that can sneak into Heliodor Castle is on the cliff of Heliodor Hill.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3828: "The path to the underground waterway that can sneak into Heliodor Castle is on the cliff of Heliodor Hill.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37cf: "That's the only way into the castle... With the Heliodor Key, you can sneak in from the waterway.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3802: "That's the only way into the castle... With the Heliodor Key, you can sneak in from the waterway.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3836: "That's the only way into the castle... With the Heliodor Key, you can sneak in from the waterway.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37de: "So monsters don't notice, we've forbidden a send-off, but our hearts are one. You are our hope... I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3811: "So monsters don't notice, we've forbidden a send-off, but our hearts are one. You are our hope... I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3845: "So monsters don't notice, we've forbidden a send-off, but our hearts are one. You are our hope... I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|385e: "West through Napgarna Jungle there's a valley leading to Soltiana Coast.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3869: "Past the mountain checkpoint beyond it, Mount Pang Lai is right there.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3875: "The people at the summit of Mount Pang Lai seem to be connected to the Luminary. They'll surely help you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3884: "{var:1}... no, Luminary of hope. Join forces with Hendrik and surely save the world!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|389c: "Oh, my daughter Jade! You've come back, truly come back!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38a4: "I must apologize from my heart for the sixteen years you lost... and the many irreparable mistakes... I'm sorry.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38b5: "I have a mountain of things to say, but you're on a journey to save the world. I know you wouldn't want to be held back.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38c5: "Jade, when all is over, please come back to this land. Let's have a quiet talk, just parent and child.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38da: "...{var:1}. It will be a harsh journey, but please take care of Jade.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|38e4: "However many hardships stand in your way, join forces with your brave companions and surely save the world.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3900: "It may sound selfish, but when you return, I have a mountain of work to ask of you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|390c: "No one but you is fit to stand between Cobblestone and the Kingdom of Heliodor.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|391a: "When you've fulfilled your journey's purpose, return to the bastion as soon as you can. Everyone is waiting for you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|392f: Your eyes meet Ritaliphon's.⏎He has very clever eyes.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3938: Your eyes meet Ritaliphon's.⏎He has very clever eyes.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3941: Your eyes meet Ritaliphon's.⏎He looks somewhat anxious.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|394a: Ritaliphon is looking at Hendrik⏎with lonely eyes.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3952: This is Hendrik's beloved horse Ritaliphon.⏎He looks somehow happy.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3968: "I have no home to go back to... The day the great tree fell, my family and friends disappeared.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|399b: "I have no home to go back to... The day the great tree fell, my family and friends disappeared.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39b8: "I have no home to go back to... The day the great tree fell, my family and friends disappeared.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3975: "Big brother... what should I do from now on...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39a8: "Big brother... what should I do from now on...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39c5: "Big brother... what should I do from now on...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3980: "This has happened to me before. Monsters suddenly attacked and everything went dark...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|398a: "I can't remember anything after that. When I try, my head goes ping and hurts.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39ca: It seems she's all alone.⏎Tell Seychelle about⏎Medal Academy for Girls?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39dc: "...Medal Academy for Girls. What a weird name. But if I go to school, I'll surely make friends.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39e8: "I'm a bit nervous, but I'll go to that school. Thank you for telling me, big brother.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39f7: "Thank you for talking with me. Being alive is already lucky, so I shouldn't be down.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ade: "Beyond here is Napgarna Jungle, a forest of death swarming with evil monsters.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ae7: "Even skilled fighters who go in alone won't come back alive. If you value your life, stay away.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3af7: "Go back! Go back! The enemy's target is the Last Bastion! We'll hold here somehow!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b05: "The monster army seems to have withdrawn, but remnants may remain nearby. Better not go beyond here now.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b1e: "Lord Hendrik, I'm truly sorry. If only Lord Jasper were here now, how reassuring that would be...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b2e: "...If we defeat the monster that creates the dark, someday Jasper will return. Until then, please bear with it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b3a: "Y-yes! I spoke out of turn! I'll guard the bastion with all my might!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b45: "Past the Napgarna Jungle! From the collapsed cliff of Heliodor Hill you can enter the castle's waterway!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b66: "Past the Napgarna Jungle! From the collapsed cliff of Heliodor Hill you can enter the castle's waterway!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b55: "When tired from fighting, there's a ruined church on Heliodor Hill, so rest your body there!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b76: "When tired from fighting, there's a ruined church on Heliodor Hill, so rest your body there!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b87: "Beyond here is Napgarna Jungle, a forest of death swarming with evil monsters.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b9f: "Beyond here is Napgarna Jungle, a forest of death swarming with evil monsters.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b90: "We repaired the log bridge to Soltiana Coast, so go ahead with confidence!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bb5: "I've kept watch here for months already... You're the first to make it here alone.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bbf: "Now that you're here, there's nothing to worry about. The Last Bastion is past the big south entrance, so just a little more.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bd3: "The road to Heliodor Castle, where dark clouds well up, has been destroyed by monsters.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c14: "The road to Heliodor Castle, where dark clouds well up, has been destroyed by monsters.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bde: "Beyond this bridge is a shortcut to death. Unless it's urgent, you should return to the bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c02: "You must be tired after battle. Monsters are beyond, so it's dangerous. Please return to the bastion once.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c1f: "Now the only way into the castle is through Napgarna Jungle. It's dangerous, so please be careful...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c32: "The darkness over Heliodor has cleared, and the monster creating eternal dark is gone. It's all thanks to you two.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c3f: "When a peaceful world comes, we'll surely rebuild Heliodor and await your return.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c50: "Welcome back, Luminary! The rumor of your defeating the Dark One has reached the Last Bastion!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c5b: "Everyone at the bastion is waiting eagerly for your return!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c6f: "Beyond is the Emerald Coast, where monsters are stronger than here. I'm keeping watch so no one gets hurt.

tm.「お兄さん……もしも 戦いに出るようなら\n オラのぶんまで しっかり頼む……。: "Mister... if you go to battle, please do well for my share too...
tm.「今回は ケガ人が少ないそうだから\n メイドさんを ひとりじめできるぜ。\n: "They say few were hurt this time, so I get the maid all to myself. Heh heh, lucky I got hurt.
tm.「オレは アンタのためなら\n ケガも病気も すぐに 治すぜ！\n だから オレ: "For you I'd heal any injury or illness right away! So go on a date with me!
tm.「砦の外で 魔物の群れと戦った時に\n 信じられない光景を見たんだ。: "When we fought a pack of monsters outside the bastion, I saw an unbelievable sight.
tm.「襲いかかってくる 魔物の群れの後ろにな\n 人間の男が 立っていたんだよ。: "Behind the swarm of attacking monsters stood a human man.
tm.「それから ずっと考えているんだ……。\n オレたちが 戦っている相手は\n 本: "I've been thinking ever since... whether what we're fighting really is monsters...
tm.「見張りからの 報告によれば\n 今回の 魔物軍団の襲撃は\n 過去 最大の規模: "According to the lookouts, this monster army's attack is the largest yet...
tm.「砦に来たばっかりだってのに\n こんな戦いに 巻き込まれるなんて\n アンタも: "You just arrived at the bastion and got dragged into such a battle. You're unlucky.
tm.「魔物は 退却したらしいが\n まだ 油断は できないからな。\n 俺は しっか: "The monsters seem to have retreated, but we can't let our guard down. I'll keep a sharp watch!
